scope: Consent view projections and CLI UUID preflight, farmer-identity date preflight, digital-finance evidence JSON preflight, and adoption-readiness review queue contract

preserved_behavior: check reader filters, exact parameter order, and LIMIT 1
list reader optional party/status filters, parameter order, and party/category/purpose ordering
serialized row fields and current internal visibility boundary

invariants: malformed UUID, ISO date/datetime, or JSON values fail through argparse before PostgreSQL acquisition
valid UUID values are canonicalized, valid date values retain date/datetime types, and valid evidence JSON is decoded before handler dispatch
omitted optional values retain existing behavior
strict OpenAPI/runtime item and page contract bound to the requested location and page
finite NUMERIC levels stay in the migration-supported 0–999.999 range
remediation text is nullable and within migration character/byte bounds
timestamps are aware, assessment IDs unique, and rows follow assessed_at DESC, assessment_id DESC
continuations beyond offset 10000 become a terminal offset_limited page
malformed output fails with sanitized no-store response and the console validates pages before rendering

verification.focused_tests_command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_stakeholder_consent.py tests/test_cli_consent_uuid_preflight.py tests/test_cli_farmer_identity_scope.py tests/test_cli_digital_finance_scope.py tests/test_gateway_solution_lifecycle_adoption_readiness.py tests/test_operator_console_solution_lifecycle.py -q
verification.runtime_sql_inventory: refreshed and current; unresolved write review ledger current with 42 tracked candidates

rollback: Revert the route/model and console validation, consent projections, CLI parsers, focused tests, evidence, and runtime SQL inventory snapshot. No schema migration or data rollback is required.
